authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4963 chagala sense 1 explicitly gives Bengali cheli and Oriya cheḷi goat. Adivasi Oriya/Bhatri celi and Adivasi Oriya seli fit this regional feminine goat family with source initial aspiration/sibilant and lateral notation retained. The elided-g cheli comparison supports this branch; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: seli.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8214 *pilla explicitly gives Oriya pilā small and as a noun child. Adivasi Oriya/Bhatri pila child matches this established Indo-Aryan family. Turner identifies a deeper Dravidian origin, citing Tamil piḷḷai; this comparative link does not posit direct borrowing from Tamil into either survey language or settle their local Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: pila.
